svg.title: Replication, then failover or test failover
svg.desc: Site Recovery's Mobility agent on vm-app in uksouth stages the disk's writes in the cache storage account, and they are replicated to a Standard HDD replica disk in ukwest, managed by rsv-lab with policy-6h. A failover creates the VM in vnet-target, as the network mapping says, where it answers "vm-app in ukwest"; a test failover uses the isolated vnet-test instead.
